items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He played a very important part in my career.

ctx.x: He was what you call a sportsman; he had a nightclub and he became very wealthy among the people there in East Liberty and he was called the Black Prince of East Liberty. I met him when I was 12 years old. He taught me to drive a car. In fact there was about 6 young girls where we went to school. They could all drive but they had to ask me if they could drive the car. He played a very important part in my career.
